about_short_description.short_description: Amplitude is a product intelligence platform that provides digital product tools that help teams run and grow their businesses.

product.name: Amplitude Analytics Platform
product.description: A cloud-based digital analytics platform for analyzing user behavior, product usage, customer journeys, and business outcomes across digital products and websites.

product.name: Amplitude AI
product.description: AI capabilities that let teams query behavioral data, automate analysis, process customer feedback, and connect Amplitude insights to external AI tools.

product.name: Product Analytics
product.description: Behavioral analytics for examining product usage, user journeys, funnels, engagement, retention, and other event-based metrics.

product.name: Session Replay
product.description: A session visualization tool that records and lets teams review user interactions to understand behavior behind quantitative product metrics.

product.name: Experimentation
product.description: A/B testing and feature experimentation capabilities for evaluating product changes, web experiences, feature rollouts, and personalized experiences.

product.name: Feature Management
product.description: A feature delivery and control service for shipping changes, managing feature flags, targeting user groups, and coordinating releases.
